questionHi: 16 विद्यार्थियों के अंकों का औसत 43 निकाला गया। बाद में पता चला कि एक विद्यार्थी के 33 को 49 लिख दिया गया था। सही औसत क्या है?

question: The average of 8 numbers is 23. The average of the first 2 is 21 and the average of the next 3 is 17. The 6th number is 2 less than the 7th and 5 less than the 8th. What is the 8th number?
solution: Sum of 8 = 184. First 2 = 42, next 3 = 51, so the last 3 add up to 184 − 42 − 51 = 91. With the 6th = x: x + (x + 2) + (x + 5) = 91, so 3x = 84 and x = 28. The 8th = 28 + 5 = 33.
questionHi: 8 संख्याओं का औसत 23 है। पहली 2 का औसत 21 और अगली 3 का औसत 17 है। 6वीं संख्या 7वीं से 2 कम और 8वीं से 5 कम है। 8वीं संख्या क्या है?

question: The average of 8 consecutive odd numbers is 36. If the next 3 consecutive odd numbers are also included, what is the new average?
solution: The smallest number is 36 − 7 = 29. Now there are 11 evenly spaced numbers from it, so the middle moves up by 3 × 2 ÷ 2 = 3: new average = 36 + 3 = 39.
questionHi: 8 क्रमागत विषम संख्याओं का औसत 36 है। यदि अगली 3 क्रमागत विषम संख्याएँ भी शामिल कर ली जाएँ, तो नया औसत क्या होगा?
solutionHi: सबसे छोटी संख्या 36 − 7 = 29 है। अब उससे शुरू होकर 11 समान अंतर वाली संख्याएँ हैं, अतः बीच का मान 3 × 2 ÷ 2 = 3 बढ़ जाता है: नया औसत = 36 + 3 = 39।

question: The average of 9 consecutive odd numbers is 13. What is the product of the smallest and the largest of them?
solution: The average of evenly spaced numbers is the middle value, so the smallest is 13 − 8 = 5 and the largest is 13 + 8 = 21. Product = 5 × 21 = 105.
questionHi: 9 क्रमागत विषम संख्याओं का औसत 13 है। इनमें सबसे छोटी और सबसे बड़ी संख्या का गुणनफल क्या है?
solutionHi: समान अंतर वाली संख्याओं का औसत बीच का मान होता है, अतः सबसे छोटी 13 − 8 = 5 और सबसे बड़ी 13 + 8 = 21 है। गुणनफल = 5 × 21 = 105।

question: The average of 15 numbers is 69. The average of the first 8 is 68 and the average of the last 8 is 70. What is the 8th number?
solution: First 8 + last 8 = 8 × 68 + 8 × 70 = 1104, which counts the 8th number twice. All 15 add up to 15 × 69 = 1035. So the 8th number = 1104 − 1035 = 69.

question: The average of 20 numbers is 25. The average of 3 of them is 18 and the average of another 6 of them is 23. What is the average of the remaining numbers?
solution: Sum of all = 20 × 25 = 500. The two groups add up to 3 × 18 + 6 × 23 = 192. The other 11 add up to 308, so their average = 308 ÷ 11 = 28.
